sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for MMM; congressional activity is mixed and aged (99+ days old), market fear/greed is neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (310 level) with imminent NFP event in 1 day creates severe near-term volatility risk; earnings in 19 days adds secondary binary event risk despite normal yield curve.
